Creative Full Stack Developer - London based
Experience Design
London
Hybrid

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer with 3-5 years experience and a genuine interest in AI and creative technology. You’re curious about where creativity and technology are heading, and excited by the chance to help shape what’s next. You enjoy building across the full stack and want to bring that into a creative studio where the ideas are ambitious, the challenges are varied, and experimentation is part of the process.

You’ll sit with designers and strategists, not across a wall from them. You’ll build brands at an independent studio without layers of agency bureaucracy. You won’t sit downstream of the work. You’ll help define what’s possible, then build it.

Who we are.

We are a group of people who make beautiful, original brands that change the world for the better. We’re fuelled by creativity and reject convention. We are trusted by some of the world’s most interesting companies, including Formula 1, TikTok, Hulu, Audible, Roli, ITV X, British Land, ESPN, Channel 4, Eurosport, Netflix and AC Milan. Brands that seek to be brave and challenge convention.

Our studio home is based in London (N1), and we come together at least 3 days a week to enjoy the space, collaborate and time together. Studio time and our wonderful surroundings are very important for creativity to thrive. Working together enables us to approach new ideas and inventions creatively and to enjoy the journey.

We partner with brands and in-house creative teams across the world from our London studio. We seek revolution rather than evolution and embrace change to remain fiercely original.

Great design is born of difference; we constantly seek new perspectives and identities to build our team. We’re a vibrant, eclectic, open group of people from South Korea, Iran, Venezuela and everywhere in between, which makes for a rich environment full of ideas.

How we see technology.

We’re interested in what technology makes possible, not technology for its own sake. Emerging and intelligent tools are changing how brands and systems meet the world. We bring the same care, judgement and invention to that shift as we do to everything else.

Engineering here is craft, not plumbing. It isn’t an executional add-on. It’s a system-level way of building brands and design systems that work everywhere, for everyone. We’re not chasing novelty. We’re building better tools, more useful systems and more meaningful experiences.

We have a view on AI. We think it will become invisible infrastructure, and that systems will increasingly learn to prefer the average. Our bet is on conviction over efficiency. If you’re tired of the hype and want to build with people who have actually thought about it, you’ll feel at home.

Our Stack.

We build in Next.js and React, TypeScript end to end, SCSS Modules for styling, and Convex or Supabase for data and realtime. Much of our interesting brand work lives in the creative-web layer; React Three Fiber, Three.js, GLSL shaders, Motion and increasingly in AI-native builds with the Vercel AI SDK.

You don’t need to have shipped in every one of these. You do need to know at least one part of this stack deeply deeply enough to have opinions, to know why you’d reach for it, and to catch when something’s subtly wrong.

Bonus, not required: Node.js, React Native, Rive, WebGL post-processing, or experience wiring up embeddings, RAG and agent workflows.

You have a strong eye for design and understand that great digital experiences rely on both thoughtful interaction and well-crafted code. You notice when something doesn’t feel quite right and know how to improve it. You’ll prototype, build, test and iterate to bring early-stage ideas to life.

You’re proactive, comfortable with uncertainty and motivated by curiosity. Rather than waiting for direction, you bring ideas, explore possibilities, learn through making and share what you discover along the way.

What you do.

These are just some of the things we’d expect. Brilliance comes in many forms though; our minds are always open.

You write and own code across the full stack, confidently developing front-end and back-end experiences that bring ambitious creative ideas to life.

You read code as carefully as you write it. You work fluently with AI, and you know when not to. Agents and automation are part of how you build but you bring judgement to it. When to reach for a tool, when to write it yourself, and how to tell the difference.

You prototype rapidly, using experimentation and iteration to test ideas and accelerate learning before investing in polished solutions.

You collaborate closely with designers, creative directors and strategists from the earliest stages of a project, contributing technical thinking that helps shape ideas rather than simply delivering them.

You’re comfortable working in ambiguity, embracing evolving briefs and adapting as ideas develop through experimentation, feedback and collaboration.

You communicate technical concepts with clarity, helping colleagues and clients understand opportunities, constraints and emerging technologies without unnecessary complexity.

You contribute to the studio’s culture of learning by sharing discoveries, experiments and new ways of thinking.

You build practical, well-crafted solutions while maintaining a maker’s mindset balancing technical excellence with speed, experimentation and creative ambition.

Senior Full-Stack Entwickler:in

Wir sind Feinheit: eine holokratisch geführte Kommunikations- und Webagentur mit Standorten in Zürich und Bern und rund 20 Mitarbeitenden. Seit 2006 entwickeln wir Kommunikationslösungen und digitale Werkzeuge für Projekte, die der Welt gut tun. Als Mitglied der Leading Swiss Agencies gehören wir zu den führenden Agenturen der Schweiz.

Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir als Ergänzung für unser Team eine:n

Senior Full-Stack Entwickler:in

Dein Pensum: 70-100%

Dein Arbeitsort: Zürich, mit der Möglichkeit für Home Office. Unser technisches Team arbeitet vor Ort, deshalb ist regelmässige Anwesenheit in Zürich erwünscht. Home Office (und Bern) ist möglich.

Das wirst du bei Feinheit tun

Du programmierst neue Websites und Webapplikationen – vom Backend (Python, Django) über die Datenbank bis ins Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

Du überwachst während der Arbeitszeit den Betrieb unserer Websites. Fehlermeldungen behältst du im Blick, reagierst selbst auf auftretende Fehler und eskalierst, wenn nötig.

Du bringst deine technische Expertise in der Problemlösung ein – intern im Projektteam und extern gegenüber der Kundschaft.

Du entwickelst unsere IT-Infrastruktur mit, insbesondere die Hosting- und Monitoring-Umgebung.

Das bringst du mit

Damit du bei uns durchstartest, solltest du das Folgende auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

Fundierte Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung – sowohl im Backend wie auch im Frontend.

Solide Backend-Kenntnisse in einer modernen Programmiersprache (idealerweise Python) sowie Verständnis für Datenbanken (SQL).

Vertrautheit mit Unix-/Linux-Systemen, die Arbeit auf der Kommandozeile ist für dich selbstverständlicher Alltag.

Echtes Interesse und Freude am Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, moderne Frameworks). Hier willst du mehr als nur mithalten.

Die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für Betrieb und Monitoring zu übernehmen: Fehler früh erkennen, selbst beheben oder gezielt eskalieren.

Neugierde und Lust am Lernen. Im KI-Zeitalter eignet man sich neue Werkzeuge und Frameworks schnell an – das siehst du als Chance.

Analytisch-konzeptionelles Denken, starke Eigeninitiative sowie eine lösungs- und dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Gerne Agentur- oder Start-Up-Erfahrung.

Konkrete Erfahrung mit Django, unserem Haupt-Framework. Falls nicht: Wer die Grundlagen mitbringt, arbeitet sich bei uns schnell ein.

Erfahrung mit (p)react oder einem anderen modernen SPA-Framework.

Erfahrung mit Error-Monitoring-Tools wie Sentry.

Kenntnisse in Hosting, Deployment und CI/CD.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Dein Alltag ist durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Organisationen auf Seite der Auftraggeberschaft abwechslungsreich: Wir arbeiten für NGO, politische Organisationen, öffentliche Institutionen, KMU sowie Kultur- und Bildungsinstitutionen.

Durch unser Angebot massgeschneiderter Web-Lösungen bringt jedes Projektsetting neue Aufgaben mit sich.

In unserem holokratischen Organisationsmodell hast du grosse Einflussmöglichkeiten hinsichtlich der Governance, deiner Aufgaben und der Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Team.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass eine interdisziplinäre und selbstorganisierte Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe nicht nur zu den besten Ergebnissen in einem Projekt, sondern auch zu einem guten Teamspirit beiträgt. Mit derselben Überzeugung streben wir eine diverse Teamzusammensetzung an und achten beispielsweise auf ausgeglichene Geschlechterverhältnisse.

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist eine Tradition: Unsere Köchin zaubert drei Tage die Woche ein leckeres und gesundes Zmittag auf dem Tisch. Ein weiteres Mal darf auf Kosten der Firma etwas von auswärts geholt werden.

Weiterbildung finden wir unterstützungswürdig. Es steht dir deshalb jedes Jahr ein separates Budget für Weiterbildungstätigkeiten zur Verfügung.

Ausserdem gibt es bei uns flexible Jahresarbeitszeit, fünf Wochen Ferien, ein transparentes und nachvollziehbares Lohnsystem sowie 4 Wochen Vaterschafts- und 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub.

Lead Programmer
· (195583)

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

HDR is a Top 10 Architectural & Engineering (A&E) firm in the United States as ranked by Engineering News Record and is also one of the largest employee-owned A&E companies in the United States.

HDR has been selected to run the Installation Engineering and Installation Management functions of the Civil Engineer Squadron for the United Stated Air Force Academy (USAFA). As such, we will be placing a multi-disciplinary A&E team of 50+ professionals at the Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs.

The contract is expected to begin in early 2026 and covers an eight-year period from 2026 through 2034. The U.S. Air Force Academy is one of the premier universities in our country and is one of the most widely visited locations in all of Colorado.

The Air Force Academy has a rich history and a unique mission to educate and train future Air Force leaders. HDR is honored to be selected for these components of the of the Base Maintenance Contract (BMC) in conjunction with Tessera, who will be running and leading the master contract with the Air Force.

HDR will be performing wide-ranging facility management services to include but not limited to: planning, programming, design, asset management, construction inspection, energy management, real estate, environmental, cultural resources, space planning, CAD, GIS, cost estimating, and numerous other functions.

Ideal candidates will have knowledge and/or experience with federal contracts and/or the Air Force Civil Engineering Squadron. They will also have a strong enthusiasm to ensure the cadets and future Air Force Leaders live and learn in state-of-the-art facilities and have the necessary resources to serve our country to the best of their abilities.

This position is full time and located on-site at the USAFA.

In the role of Programmer Lead your duties are predominantly intellectual in nature and vary depending on each project’s needs. The position requires discretion and judgment based upon knowledge of Unified Facilities Criteria, Air Force Programming requirements e.g. DAFMAN 32-1084 and Air Force Institute of Technology programming course instruction e.g. WMGT 423. We'll count on you to:

Be responsible for managing the Facility AMP and coordinate project authorizations independently, reflecting a leadership role within the installation planning team.

Lean on your deep technical knowledge of AFI 32-1032 and AFI 32-1023 for planning and programming appropriated fund maintenance, repair, and construction projects for garnering funding from higher headquarters.

Have a deep understanding of the facility programming process to articulate the requirements and benefits of each project to the Air Force as well as any adverse impacts not approving a project may have.

Identify project requirements (define project scopes) to satisfy current and future mission needs.
Provide advice and assistance to the Engineering Flight in writing, coordinating, and processing DOD Form 1391s in support of Facility Sustainment Restoration Modernization (FSRM) and Military Construction (MILCON) projects.
Manage the development of 1391's, threshold reporting and compliance with AFI's.
Develop rough order of magnitude (ROM) construction cost estimates utilizing government provided software (similar to RS Means).
Be responsible for a wide range of detailed deliverables including justifications, space requirement calculations, site plans, coordination with HHQ authorization tools, and the integration of funding timelines with construction schedules.
Provide advice in development of the Base Comprehensive Asset Management Plan (BCAMP).
Provide advice with documenting requirements and acquiring both the authority and resources necessary to accomplish the work.
Provide advice with obtaining and verifying information to justify and gain Congressional funding approval.
Provide advice in support of working with Civil Engineering Operations Flight and other USAFA mission partners through asset management to develop requirements.
Provide advice in support of generating documentation in pre-acquisition efforts for FSRM and MILCON projects.
Develop and submit project lists (e.g., BCAMP, MILCON, Unspecified Minor Military Construction (UMMC), Energy Resilience and Conservation Investment Program (ERCIP), etc.).

A minimum of 3 years Air Force Civil Engineering Squadron programming experience
Ability to work in person and on site at United States Air Force Academy
Ability to pass a background check
Knowledge of the Unified Facilities Criteria
Completion of AFIT training courses WMGT 331, 417 & 423, WENG 400 & 500
Due to client contract requirements, US Citizenship - US Naturalized citizen is required
This position is subject to a governmental background check

Bachelor's degree in related fields (preferably engineering, architecture, or construction)
A minimum of 10 years experience in the Architecture/Engineering/Construction industry
Ability to interact and work alongside daily with various stakeholders
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to submit and pass a background check
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The Product
In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI.

You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks.

Your work will ensure we can reliably render, understand, and extract valuable information while minimising cost and latency.

s.h: In this position, your responsibility will be to
s.t:
Design and build large-scale rendering systems for modern web applications
Develop browser-based rendering infrastructure capable of executing complex JavaScript applications reliably
Research how modern frontend frameworks render and deliver content
Improve rendering quality, completeness, and performance across diverse websites
Optimise rendering cost, latency, resource utilisation, and throughput at internet scale
Translate rendering research into reliable production systems

s.h: You may be a good fit if you
s.t:
Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems and are an expert in several of the following areas:
Browser Rendering
Chromium rendering pipeline — DOM, Layout, Paint, and Compositing
JavaScript execution inside browsers and rendering lifecycle and page readiness
Headless browser execution and browser instrumentation
Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)
Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or similar frameworks Modern Web Applications
React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and modern frontend architectures
Server-side rendering (SSR), client-side rendering (CSR), and streaming rendering
Single-page applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
Resource loading, lazy loading, and modern JavaScript bundles

s.h: Strong candidates may also have experience with
s.t:
Building and operating high-throughput content processing pipelines at internet scale
Distributed systems design and performance optimisation
Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community
Conference talks or technical publications
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

s.h: What's it like to work at Nebius
s.t: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

OpenAI’s Healthcare team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that support patients, clinicians, and healthcare organizations while setting a high standard for deploying AI responsibly in a high-stakes domain.
On the Healthcare team, we are building products and infrastructure that bring OpenAI’s capabilities into healthcare organizations and clinical workflows. We serve health care systems, insurance companies, and the broad range of healthcare IT companies. Our products include connecting ChatGPT with healthcare data and systems and building reliable enterprise experiences that can operate within complex security, privacy, compliance, and interoperability requirements.
We work closely with product, research, design, security, privacy, GTM, and our healthcare customers to turn powerful AI capabilities into dependable products that clinicians and healthcare organizations use in their everyday work.

We are looking for backend and full-stack software engineers to build the systems behind OpenAI’s healthcare products.
You will work across backend services, APIs, data systems, integrations, and product surfaces to connect AI with healthcare workflows and enterprise data. You’ll tackle the technical challenges involved in making these systems secure, reliable, observable, and scalable enough for real-world healthcare environments.
This is a product-engineering role for someone who can move between customer problems and complex system architecture, and who is comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end.

Design and build backend and full-stack systems powering OpenAI’s healthcare products.
Build services, APIs, and data pipelines that connect OpenAI products with healthcare systems and enterprise data.
Develop integrations with electronic health records and other healthcare data sources.
Design systems that meet demanding requirements around privacy, security, permissions, compliance, and data governance.
Own features and systems from early architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
Build reliable systems capable of handling complex data flows, partial failures, and evolving integration requirements.
Partner closely with product, research, security, privacy, GTM, and healthcare organizations to translate real-world workflows into scalable products.
Improve the reliability, performance, observability, and operational maturity of production healthcare systems.
Take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and drive them toward practical, durable solutions.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Are a strong backend or full-stack engineer who enjoys building durable production systems.
Have 5+ years of experience writing maintainable, production-quality software.
Have strong experience with backend services, APIs, data systems, or distributed systems.
Are comfortable reasoning about system architecture, data models, authentication, permissions, and integration boundaries.
Have experience owning production systems at scale, including observability, testing, incident response, migrations, and rollout.
Can move between product requirements and technical architecture without losing ownership of either.
Operate with high agency and are comfortable taking ambiguous problems from definition through production.
Enjoy working directly with cross-functional partners and customers to understand complex workflows.
Care deeply about reliability, privacy, security, and correctness.
Are motivated by the opportunity to improve healthcare through AI.

Experience building enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
Experience with distributed systems, backend architecture, or large-scale data pipelines.
Experience building integrations with complex third-party systems or APIs.

At Jumio , the Software Development Engineer IV - QA (SDE-IV, QA) is a senior technical role focused on ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of highly scalable web portals and distributed backend systems. Our platform spans multiple Java Spring Boot microservices and customer-facing web portals , deployed across AWS ECS, EKS, and Lambda , and integrated through event-driven messaging using SNS/SQS .
In this role you will design and drive the test automation strategy for both UI (Playwright) and API/service layers, set the quality bar for the team, and act as a force multiplier — mentoring other engineers and embedding quality earlier in the development lifecycle. You will work closely with development, product, and DevOps teams to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality, scalability, and security.
This is a hands-on senior IC role: you will write code, but you will also influence architecture, own cross-service test strategy, and make build-vs-buy decisions for testing tooling.
T-Shaped Engineering Expectation
As part of Jumio 's engineering culture, you will adopt a T-shaped engineering approach. Beyond deep expertise in test automation and quality engineering, you will contribute across the development lifecycle — understanding software architecture, participating in design and API-contract discussions, reviewing application code, and ensuring our distributed systems are testable, observable, and resilient by design.
Role Value
This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Jumio 's products. By architecting and maintaining automated testing frameworks across web, API, and event-driven layers, you will enable faster, higher-confidence releases and reduce production risk in a complex microservices environment.

Test Architecture & Strategy
Define and own the end-to-end automated test strategy across web portals and backend microservices, balancing UI, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end coverage (test pyramid).
Design test strategies for distributed, event-driven systems — including asynchronous flows through SNS/SQS , eventual consistency, idempotency, message ordering, retries, and dead-letter handling.
Automation Engineering
Develop and maintain robust test automation frameworks for web ( Playwright , Selenium, or equivalent) and API testing, using Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript .
Automate API and service-level testing (REST/JSON, and async messaging) to validate functionality, performance, and resilience.
Build maintainable, scalable framework abstractions (page objects, fixtures, data builders, reusable test harnesses) that other engineers adopt.
Cloud-Native & Non-Functional Testing
Design tests that run against services deployed on ECS, EKS, and Lambda , including environment provisioning and teardown.
Use tools like TestContainers / LocalStack to test AWS integrations (SQS/SNS, Lambda, etc.) reliably and locally.
Drive performance, load, and resilience testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust) for highly scalable services, and partner with engineering on results and bottlenecks.
Contribute to non-functional quality: basic security testing, reliability, and chaos/failure-injection where appropriate.
CI/CD & Quality Engineering
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI) to enable fast feedback and continuous delivery.
Improve test reliability — reduce flakiness, optimize execution time, enable parallelization, and improve observability of test results.
Define and track quality metrics (coverage, escape rate, MTTR, flake rate) and use them to drive decisions.
AI-Augmented Engineering
Leverage LLM-based tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate test authoring, framework development, test-data generation, and debugging — driving measurable productivity and coverage gains.
Apply AI to quality engineering workflows: generating and maintaining test cases from requirements/specs, summarizing failures and triaging flaky tests, reviewing code, and scaffolding boilerplate so the team focuses on high-value testing.
Champion responsible, effective AI adoption within the QA team — establishing prompts, patterns, and guardrails, and mentoring engineers on using these tools to work faster without compromising rigor or correctness.
Collaboration & Leadership
Partner with developers to ensure comprehensive coverage and efficient issue resolution; review application and test code.
Mentor and uplevel SDE-II/III QA engineers on automation best practices, framework design, and testing strategy.
Influence design and architecture discussions to make systems more testable and to shift quality left.
Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, methodologies, and best practices.

Strong programming skills in Java (Spring Boot ecosystem) and/or JavaScript/TypeScript .
Deep, hands-on experience with Playwright (and/or Selenium) for web automation.
Proven experience testing microservices and API-based systems, including async/event-driven architectures ( SNS/SQS or equivalent messaging — Kafka/RabbitMQ a plus).
Experience testing cloud-native applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda) and familiarity with containers/Docker and Kubernetes.

The ClickPipes - Database Integrations team builds the platform that enables real-time data replication from databases into ClickHouse at petabyte scale.
As a member of this team, you will be solving complex database-related challenges and distributed systems problems, such as understanding database internals to optimize snapshotting strategy, handling schema evolution during live replication, managing data type compatibility across systems, maintaining low end-to-end latency under unpredictable loads, and leveraging durable execution frameworks to ensure data consistency over unreliable networks.

We work in the open — our database integrations are built on PeerDB , an open-source CDC platform we actively maintain and contribute to.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

As a Software Engineer on the RL Data team, you’ll design and build the tools that researchers and external contributors use to create, review, submit, and monitor the environments and tasks behind Cursor’s reinforcement-learning runs. This is a full-stack product-engineering role embedded in a research team.
You’ll own the review and acceptance experience end to end: from rollout and transcript inspection, task-quality signals grader and reward-hacking analysis, to the workflows that move a submission into training. From there, you’ll build authoring interfaces that let researchers, vendors, and domain experts create and improve environments and tasks quickly and confidently.
Your work will significantly shorten the loop from a task idea or data sources, to candidate task, to trusted training data.
What you’ll work on
Create fast, trustworthy workflows for vendors and research team to interact effectively with each other — vendor task creation and iteration, vendor submissions, and task acceptance into training.
Build review tools for inspecting and comparing rollouts, transcripts, grader outputs, and other signals of task quality.
Develop environment-health, failure-search, versioning, and catalog experiences that make training data easy to understand, manage, and extend.
Establish a shared component kit, then use it to build self-serve interfaces for creating and improving tasks with quality checks inline.
You may be a fit if
You’ve shipped full-stack products and owned systems from user interface through storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.
You’ve built dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards—and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.
You’ve built or maintained a design system or component library and can establish durable product and engineering conventions for a fast-moving team.
You’ve designed review, QA, moderation, fraud, or acceptance workflows where users had an incentive to get past the checks, and you know how to keep those systems honest.
You care about data quality, and are willing to inspect raw data. Experience with evaluations, graders, reinforcement learning, or data-quality systems is helpful but not required.
You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.
Applying
If there appears to be a fit, we’ll schedule two or three short technical interviews focused on frontend craft for dense data and system design for a review-and-acceptance workflow. After that, we’ll invite you onsite to work on a small project using real rollouts, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

Welcome to the good side of tech 👋
You might know us as ZnanyLekarz in Poland or Doctoralia in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner.
We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month.
Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter.
In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems.
And why should you join us?
Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.
We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation.
Our challenges
Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges:
Marketplace & Search
Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops.
Practice Management Systems (PMS)
Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient.
AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic)
Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals.
Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient)
Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.
Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives.

We build systems that matter and we optimize for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability.
Small autonomous teams that own real product surfaces end-to-end
High trust and high ownership from day one
Production impact early - even as a junior engineer
AI-assisted development as a default workflow
Strong engineering culture focused on simplicity, correctness, and measurable outcomes

Good ideas win regardless of tenure or hierarchy.

Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
We are looking for an experienced backend software engineer to join our Road Safety & Telematics team. At Lyft, Telematics data is used to make Lyft safer by reducing the frequency and severity of accidents, which in turn also makes Lyft more affordable for riders and a better way to earn a living for drivers.

The Telematics team acts as a platform team that processes petabytes of mobile sensor data — millisecond-level IMU, gyroscope, and GPS signals — through a series of DAG-based transformations and ML model inferences to detect harsh driving events and convert them into normalized risk features that other Lyft services consume.
Our technology stack runs on AWS, Kubernetes, Spark, and Apache Airflow.

In this role, you'll work closely with data scientists, actuarial teams, other backend and data engineers, and product management — partnering across geos to build risk-aware products that rank and reward safe drivers, help off-board unsafe ones, notify drivers in real time, and give claims agents the tools to understand exactly what happened in a ride.

You'll also be a key technical partner to our insurance team as they optimize coverage costs and provider relationships.
If you are a seasoned engineer with a passion for innovation, high-volume data pipelines, microservices, working in cross-disciplinary environments and possess the skills to ensure the ongoing maintenance and improvement of services, you will thrive on our team!
You can read about some of the products that Telematics powers in this blog post: https://www.lyft.com/blog/posts/lyfts-impact-on-road-safety

Be a champion of the team's safety and affordability mission, serving as a reliable source of risk insights for teams across Lyft — from driver ranking and safety rewards to accident claims resolution and insurance strategy.
Lead medium to large projects, ensuring end-to-end execution with a focus on high quality and reliability.
Work cross-functionally with Data Scientists to productionize models that turn raw sensor signals into harsh-event detection and risk features, driving the team's industry-leading innovation in this space.
Drive future work to reduce latency, simplify, and improve the accuracy of both our back-end and on-device models that predict accidents before they happen.
Actively unblock and support team members, fostering a collaborative and efficient work environment.
Take a lead role in the ongoing maintenance of our Telematics systems, reducing tech debt and operating costs through sensible, data-driven design decisions.
Collaborate with product management and leadership across geos to define and execute ambitious roadmaps for Telematics.
Apply the latest AI tools to boost engineering and business productivity, sharing what you learn with the team.
Utilize your expertise in Python, AWS, Spark, SQL (Databricks/Presto), etc. to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
Participate in our team's on-call rotations, respond to incidents, and support other teams in mitigating customer-impacting events.

4+ years of software engineering industry experience
Experience in backend software development of large-scale distributed systems
Experience and/or interest in running large batch processing jobs with Spark or other large scale compute architectures
Experience and/or interest in Library development
Experience and/or interest in serving, versioning, monitoring ML models in production environments
Experience defining API schemas and developing backend services in a microservices environment

The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that.
As a Senior Software Engineer , you will design and build the core systems that issue, custody, and settle tokenized equities on-chain and keep them in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll lead technically complex projects end to end, make architectural decisions on a foundational Robinhood initiative, and work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, across multiple chains and jurisdictions.

Design, build, and operate the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities across leading blockchains, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements
Own large, technically complex projects end to end - design, implementation, rollout, and operating what you ship in a 24/7 system
Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows
Partner with product, compliance, legal, and platform teams to turn regulatory constraints into workable system design
Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Commercial Navigation helps fleets turn planned work into guided trips that are safe, efficient, and visible to the people running the operation.

We build navigation inside the Samsara Driver app and the supporting experiences around it: mobile guidance on the road, session review for fleet managers, fuel-aware routing, and safety-focused improvements that show up where drivers actually drive.

The team has a real foundation in production, and there is still a lot of greenfield ahead as we expand what navigation means for commercial fleets.
We are looking for a product-minded senior engineer who can own ambiguous problems end to end, make practical tradeoffs across surfaces, and ship work that holds up in the field. You will contribute across mobile, backend services, and web as needed, with judgment about what matters most for customers rather than a fixed layer of the stack.

This is a deeply technical problem space that blends real-time data, thoughtful UX, and platform-wide coordination to create a seamless experience under challenging conditions, like poor connectivity, dynamic job schedules, and constantly changing routes.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

Own Features End to End: Take full ownership of navigation initiatives from design through production rollout, including follow-up on quality, adoption, and customer impact after launch.
Deliver with High Engineering Standards: Write maintainable, well-tested code and hold a high bar in design and code review. Use modern development tools, including AI-assisted workflows, with sound judgment. Improve observability, testing, and the systems that keep navigation reliable in production.
Build Across the Product: Design and ship features across mobile, backend services, and web—driver navigation experiences, admin visibility, optimized routing, and safety-focused navigation capabilities.
Turn Ambiguity into Action: Clarify what you are building and why: learn from fleet managers and drivers, align with the product team on priorities, define success metrics, plan milestones, and raise risks and tradeoffs before they become surprises.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and partners in Maps, Telematics, and adjacent teams to deliver cohesive navigation experiences end to end.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

6+ years of experience
Proven experience shipping customer-facing software in production across multiple surfaces (e.g. mobile, web, and/or backend services), with depth in at least one and the ability to contribute effectively in the others.
Comfortable using AI development tools with judgment in day-to-day engineering

Experience building mobile applications, including React Native. At Samsara we also use Swift and Kotlin for native modules and in-cab experiences .
Experience shipping and maintaining features over several years, demonstrating long-term ownership .
Domain expertise in logistics, or industrial IoT, especially building mobile apps for drivers or field workers or familiarity with geospatial or mapping technologies.

s.t: HPC Systems Software Engineer – OpenCHAMI for Lugano or Zürich (professione segnalata)

Questo progetto, con sede di lavoro a Lugano o a Zurigo, si concentra sullo sviluppo e il potenziamento di OpenCHAMI per l’infrastruttura di supercalcolo di nuova generazione del CSCS. Il lavoro contribuirà alla creazione di un approccio aperto, scalabile e moderno alla gestione dei cluster per sistemi di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC) su larga scala.
L’obiettivo principale è progettare, sviluppare, integrare e implementare funzionalità di OpenCHAMI su misura per i requisiti operativi dei supercomputer del CSCS.
Il progetto affronterà le sfide legate alla gestione di sistemi HPC e di intelligenza artificiale (AI) sempre più complessi e contribuirà all’evoluzione delle tecnologie open source di gestione dei cluster di nuova generazione.

Offriamo un contratto iniziale di due anni che ti darà l’opportunità di lavorare all’avanguardia nell’ambito delle infrastrutture HPC e di intelligenza artificiale presso il CSCS, contribuendo direttamente allo sviluppo di tecnologie che supporteranno i futuri sistemi di supercalcolo.
Avrai l’opportunità di contribuire a OpenCHAMI e alle relative iniziative open source, collaborando con la più ampia comunità HPC e partecipando a programmi di grande impatto sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, tra cui HPSF, OpenCHAMI e iniziative correlate.

Sviluppare e ampliare OpenCHAMI per soddisfare i requisiti operativi e di gestione dell’infrastruttura dei sistemi di supercalcolo attuali e di prossima generazione del CSCS.
Contribuire all’ecosistema open source di OpenCHAMI, compresi lo sviluppo, l’integrazione e l’evoluzione dei servizi e dei componenti correlati alla gestione dei cluster.
Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di automazione e gestione per migliorare il provisioning, la configurazione, il monitoraggio, la manutenzione e l’efficienza operativa dei sistemi su larga scala.
Collaborare strettamente con i team operativi HPC per comprendere i requisiti e le sfide operative e tradurli in soluzioni basate su OpenCHAMI robuste, scalabili e di facile manutenzione.
Contribuire all’architettura e all’evoluzione della piattaforma OpenCHAMI, garantendo che le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili, gestibili e allineate alle esigenze dei sistemi HPC e di IA su larga scala.
Partecipare attivamente ai flussi di lavoro di sviluppo open source, tra cui la progettazione del software, l’implementazione, i test, le revisioni del codice, il tracciamento dei problemi e le discussioni tecniche all’interno della comunità OpenCHAMI.
Collaborare con partner internazionali e con la più ampia comunità HPC per sviluppare e integrare soluzioni che promuovano la gestione dei cluster open source e l’automazione delle infrastrutture.
Redigere e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica, inclusi progetti di architettura, guide all’implementazione, procedure operative e best practice.
Valutare tecnologie e approcci emergenti rilevanti per la gestione delle infrastrutture HPC, l’osservabilità e l’automazione, e contribuire alla loro adozione ove opportuno.

Accogliamo con favore ingegneri con background diversi che siano desiderosi di contribuire alla nostra missione. Cerchiamo principalmente solide basi tecniche, un buon giudizio ingegneristico e la capacità di colmare le lacune tra i diversi ambiti. Curiosità, adattabilità, disponibilità ad apprendere sul campo e potenziale di crescita contano per noi più di una perfetta corrispondenza iniziale con i requisiti tecnici.

Einleitungstext
The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates a high-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.
Projekthintergrund

This project with work location either Lugano or Zürich focuses on the development and advancement of OpenCHAMI for CSCS’s next-generation supercomputing infrastructure. The work will contribute to building an open, scalable, and modern approach to cluster management for large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) systems.
The main objective is to design, develop, integrate, and deploy OpenCHAMI capabilities tailored to the operational requirements of CSCS supercomputers.
The project will address the challenges of managing increasingly complex HPC and AI systems and contribute to the evolution of next-generation open-source cluster management technologies.

We value technical excellence, curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn and grow over a perfect checklist of skills. Working on next-generation HPC infrastructure requires a willingness to explore new technologies, tackle complex problems, and continuously develop new expertise.
If you are motivated to make a meaningful impact in this area but do not meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We offer an initially two-year contract providing the opportunity to work at the forefront of HPC and AI infrastructure at CSCS, contributing directly to the development of technologies that will support future supercomputing systems.
You will have the opportunity to contribute to OpenCHAMI and related open-source initiatives, collaborating with the broader HPC community and contributing to high-impact programs at both the national and international levels, including HPSF, OpenCHAMI, and related initiatives.
This is an opportunity to help shape how future CSCS supercomputers are managed, monitored, and operated, while contributing to open-source technologies with an impact well beyond a single system or institution.
Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
Develop and extend OpenCHAMI to meet the infrastructure management and operational requirements of CSCS’s current and next-generation supercomputing systems.
Contribute to the OpenCHAMI open-source ecosystem, including the development, integration, and evolution of related cluster management services and components.
Develop automation and management workflows to improve system provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational efficiency at scale.
Collaborate closely with HPC operations teams to understand operational requirements and challenges, and translate them into robust, scalable, and maintainable OpenCHAMI-based solutions.
Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the OpenCHAMI platform, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with the needs of large-scale HPC and AI systems.
Participate actively in open-source development workflows, including software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, issue tracking, and technical discussions within the OpenCHAMI community.

Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers.

We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next.
We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior.
This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block.
You Will
Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block.
Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform.
Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions.
Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently.
Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment.
Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use.
Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness.
You Have
Deep, current expertise with at least one major card network, ideally Visa, including direct connectivity, ISO 8583, authorization and clearing flows, stand-in processing, specifications, certification, and mandate cycles.
Personally built, certified, or operated a live direct network connection — not only integrated through a processor.
Experience working directly with card networks to land concrete outcomes, such as rulings, exceptions, extensions, configuration changes, defect fixes, or certification outcomes.
Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale.
A track record of leading technically complex, ambiguous work across team boundaries and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate area of ownership.
Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
Broad understanding of the card lifecycle, with depth in areas such as issuance and fulfillment, provisioning and activation, authorization, ledgering, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, disputes, or fraud.
Working knowledge of Mastercard and American Express, alongside deep expertise in at least one major network.
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and sound judgment in evaluating and applying AI-generated output.
Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products – Logs, RUM, APM, Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. Husky was built from the ground up at Datadog to store and query massive volumes of event data at low cost, with data fully queryable within seconds of arrival.
As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll work hands-on with a distributed storage system at petabyte scale, and help us evolve our platform to support the next level of scale that will power the AI era.

We will move from a custom storage format towards open standards (Parquet, Arrow, DataFusion) enabling on prem solutions, increasingly complex analytical/batch workloads, and powering AI observability, sustainably into the future.

You'll partner closely with Husky Ingestion, Metadata, and Platform, and increasingly with Lakehouse on the Iceberg-compatible boundary between Husky and analytical/batch workloads. You will also work with the open source community to build the next generation of reusable software solutions that can be operated at scale.
Datadog has a culture that is increasingly rare in mature technology companies. We are an engineering driven, bottom up, high agency/high responsibility culture–where everyone is empowered and expected to drive the technological and strategic direction of the business over time.

We are a blameless culture where we believe supporting each other through challenges produces the best outcomes over time and our track record corroborates this. We are open source champions.

We believe in the flexibility of working remotely but also the value of bringing people together across our various offices worldwide–and our offices are nice places to work.

Drive Husky to the next level of adoption by migrating our storage format to open source Parquet and re-imagine compaction on a format-agnostic, DataFusion-based substrate
Drive concrete cost-reduction work: block-level inverted index compression, combining the database with external objects at the row level, and storage tiering/caching
Scale our solution to enable customers to manage event versioning at scale, using temporal-database techniques.
Play an influential role in operating and deciding how to best operate our service going forward.
Work across the write path (with Ingestion) and toward a cleaner Iceberg-based handoff to ADP/Lakehouse for batch/analytical workloads

Enthusiastic and experienced with large-scale distributed systems and/or storage engines
Comfortable with improving and operating large distributed systems that customers rely on for critical business functions
Strong fundamentals in columnar/file storage formats (Parquet, ORC, Arrow) or comparable systems
Bonus : experience with Go, Java, or Rust; with compaction or compression/encoding schemes (RLE, dictionary, delta, gorilla); with object storage (S3/GCS/Azure Blob) at scale, including caching and cost optimization; with Kafka and stream processing; or with Kubernetes

s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
Our New Ventures team is focused on growing our global footprint by launching our core products in new markets and expanding across multiple brands and verticals. We’re a globally distributed team operating across 7+ brands in 15+ countries, building desirable products and seamless, engaging experiences that customers haven’t seen before.

With many exciting projects underway, we’re driven to generate the next billion-dollar business—so if you’re passionate about tackling bold challenges, join us!
We are a close-knit group of engineers of different stripes - developers, designers, and product owners - who are working together to solve interesting e-commerce and supply chain problems around how people eat. Sometimes, this involves implementing features to improve the user
journey and making it easier for our customers to buy amazing food. Other times, this means creating stable software solutions that keep our distribution centers running.
We are looking for an engineer to help implement solutions & write beautiful code, working with various team members as we build out our consumer facing applications & the infrastructure that supports them. As a member of our Toronto team, you’ll work with highly-skilled engineers, who in collaboration with our other global teams, have turned HelloFresh into the #1 meal delivery service in the world!

Design, develop, and deploy software solutions across HelloFresh markets and brands, with a focus on building great experiences for our customers and internal users
Take ownership of features end-to-end, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through development, quality engineering, deployment, and monitoring
Work closely with Product Owners, Designers, and other engineers to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions
Build modern, accessible, and performant frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and related technologies
Contribute across the full stack, including APIs, backend services, integrations, and data where needed
Participate in technical discovery, architecture, and design discussions, helping the team make pragmatic technical decisions
Apply DevOps practices and engineering best practices to build, deploy, and operate reliable software
Use AI coding agents as part of your everyday engineering workflow to explore, plan, develop, debug, and improve software
Continuously develop your technical skills and share knowledge with the team through code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and technical discussions

An active, solution-oriented member of an autonomous, cross-functional agile team, collaborating with Product Owners, Designers, Backend and Frontend Engineers, and other stakeholders
4+ years of professional software development experience working in an agile software development team
2+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, or a similar modern JavaScript framework such as Angular or Vue
Strong understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, API integration, performance, and accessibility
Proven experience delivering end-to-end features, taking ownership from initial implementation through deployment and monitoring
Hands-on experience with continuous delivery and deploying customer-facing applications
Experience writing unit, integration, and functional quality engineering tests, as well as working with practices such as TDD or BDD
Solid understanding of backend architecture, with the ability to work with APIs, service contracts, and backend engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions
Experience with server-side technologies such as Next.js, Nest.js, Remix, Node.js, or similar
Proficiency with GraphQL and/or REST APIs, with a working knowledge of SQL for data exploration and product requirements
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Honeycomb, Sentry, Datadog, or New Relic
Experience working with experimentation, such as A/B or multivariate testing
Comfortable working with cloud-based applications, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices
A solid understanding of product engineering principles and a willingness to challenge requirements and help identify the right solution for the customer and business
Working knowledge of one or more backend languages such as Node.js, Python, Go, or Java
Solid hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot beyond casual experimentation. You use AI as a thought partner to navigate unfamiliar codebases, explore solutions, plan and implement changes, and improve your development workflow. You understand that the quality of AI output depends heavily on the context, specifications, constraints, and examples you provide, and you have practical habits around reviewing, testing, and validating AI-generated work.
Bonus if you have experience with mobile app development, either through React Native or native iOS/Android

Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.
Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team
Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

As a Software Engineer on this new team, you will be responsible for developing cutting edge technologies related to enabling deployment at scale of AI applications.

You will take on challenging, high-visibility projects that improve and enhance the performance, scalability, and reliability of the distributed systems infrastructure for this new product.

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

Design, build and deliver well-tested core pieces of the platform in collaboration with other vested parties

A workplace culture where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work - we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation

Experience writing and testing software whether as part of an internship, in a personal project, in a coding competition, or for research
Good verbal and written technical communication skills, desire to collaborate with colleagues
Eager to learn, with a strong technical background
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

You will take ownership of release-based testing, system observability, and automation services to ensure that weekly software releases are delivered seamlessly and with high quality across mission-critical systems.

Design, implement, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both server- and client-side systems using Java, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium.
Develop and execute comprehensive end-to-end and system test plans to validate new software changes against existing customer deployment patterns.
Set up and manage automated test configurations, lab environments, and containerized test setups using Docker.
Perform release-based validation, ensuring full compatibility, high availability, and uptime across weekly deployment cycles.

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Buildkite) to reduce test execution times and eliminate flaky builds.
Manage and optimize Maven-based build structures, dependency management, and automated release workflows.
Write operational automation scripts using Python, Bash, or Groovy to automate internal infrastructure and test maintenance tasks.
Observability, Monitoring & Infrastructure
Analyze application logs and system observability metrics using tools like Splunk, Sumologic, Kibana, or ELK to identify, isolate, and debug failures.
Utilize SQL to query databases and validate complex, integrated backend scenarios.
Provide occasional on-call support and debug assistance to partner teams in North America to ensure smooth global engineering alignment.

Automation & Coding: 4+ years of Java-based test development (Selenium, TestNG, JUnit) and scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Groovy.

Observability: Strong experience leveraging monitoring tools (Splunk, Kibana, SumoLogic) to parse logs and trace test failures.
Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
Familiarity with Kubernetes, mobile testing platforms (e.g., Bitbar, Appium), or machine learning-driven test tools.
Exposure to performance or security testing within CI pipelines.

An Electron Flight Software engineer will be responsible for creation, maintenance and support of software on both the Electron rocket and associated ground-based communication systems.

Manage trade-studies

Description de l'entreprise
Swiss Medical Network est l'un des groupes de cliniques privées les plus importants de Suisse. Il s'est fixé pour objectif d'offrir des soins médicaux de premier ordre à ses patients suisses et étrangers.

Swiss Medical Network convainc par la haute qualité de ses prestations, un environnement de travail agréable et une équipe de direction expérimentée à l'esprit entrepreneurial. Le réseau exploite actuellement 21 cliniques et hôpitaux dans toute la Suisse et est présent dans les trois principales régions linguistiques.
Description du poste
En tant que Fullstack Developer (AI \& Digital Health), vous jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation numérique de nos cliniques. Vous concevez et développez des solutions logicielles innovantes assistées par l'IA, qui améliorent le parcours du patient tout en soulageant le personnel médical. Vous agissez comme un pont technique entre les exigences médicales et les technologies de pointe, garantissant que nos applications de santé numériques sont sécurisées, évolutives et conviviales.

Votre domaine d'activité
Développement \& Architecture de solutions : Conception et implémentation d'applications web Fullstack évolutives (Frontend \& Backend) pour un usage clinique et administratif.
Intégration de l'IA : Développement et intégration de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), de LLM (Large Language Models) et de services d'IA déterministes (explainable AI) dans des applications existantes et nouvelles pour soutenir les processus diagnostiques ou administratifs.
Données \& Interfaces : Connexion des applications aux systèmes primaires cliniques (KIS/HIS/DPI) en utilisant des standards d'interopérabilité modernes (ex. FHIR, HL7\) et garantie d'un échange de données fluide.
Security by Design : Garantie des standards de sécurité les plus élevés et de la conformité à la protection des données (LPD/RGPD) lors du traitement des données sensibles des patients, en étroite coordination avec le délégué à la protection des données.
DevOps \& Cloud : Mise en place et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD ainsi que gestion de l'infrastructure Cloud pour l'exploitation des solutions d'IA.
Prototyping : Développement rapide de preuves de concept (PoC) pour évaluer le potentiel des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour le quotidien clinique et les rendre tangibles.
Collaboration : Étroite coopération avec les Data Scientists, les médecins et le personnel soignant afin de créer des solutions centrées sur l'utilisateur ("User Centricity").
Votre profil
Formation : Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou qualification comparable avec un fort accent sur les technologies web modernes.
Compétences en développement : Expérience approfondie dans les frameworks Backend (ex. Python, , Java) et Frontend (ex. React, Angular, modernes, idéalement sur la Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Looker). Des connaissances en Python sont privilégiées en raison de l'orientation IA.
Expertise en IA : Expérience pratique dans l'intégration de composants IA/ML (ex. API OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face, TensorFlow) dans des environnements logiciels productifs.
Secteur de la santé : Une expérience avec les normes du secteur de la santé (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire si vous êtes prêt à vous y former. Une expérience avec le "Software as Medical Device" et les processus de certification correspondants constitue un atout majeur.
Méthode de travail : Un mode de travail autonome, agile (Scrum/Kanban) et orienté solutions. Vous avez une mentalité "Can\-Do" et prenez plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes par le code.
Personnalité : Esprit d'innovation couplé à une conscience de la qualité. Vous savez rendre des sujets techniques compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Langues : De langue maternelle allemande avec un niveau courant/négociation en français (ou inversement) ; de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont requises pour la collaboration au sein de nos équipes linguistiques régionales.
Tech\-Stack : Des connaissances en technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plateformes Cloud (Azure/GCP) et gestion de versions (Git) sont prérequis.
Informations supplémentaires
Notre offre
Innovation : Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l'innovation médicale et de développer des solutions d'IA qui apportent une véritable plus\-value à la vie des patients.
Création : Vous bénéficiez d'une grande marge de manœuvre technique dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise les circuits de décision courts et la pensée entrepreneuriale.
Environnement : Un climat de travail inspirant au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire composée de médecins et de spécialistes IT, un package salarial attractif ainsi que des prestations sociales progressistes vous attendent.
Développement : Réjouissez\-vous de projets passionnants avec les dernières technologies et une grande responsabilité personnelle au sein d'un groupe de cliniques en pleine croissance.
